planets.name: WASP-46 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-46 with a 1.43-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: WASP-46 b was found in 2011 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-46. Its orbit and size follow Ciceri et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname CICERI_ET_AL__2016): disc_year 2011, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.43037192, pl_radj 1.174, pl_bmassj 1.91
